description: This Java source file defines the SimpleServiceEngine class, which extends GenericAsyncEngine and provides methods to run services synchronously, invoking simple methods within the OFBiz framework's mini-language service engine.

classes.name: SimpleServiceEngine
classes.description: A final class extending GenericAsyncEngine that provides mechanisms to run services synchronously within the OFBiz mini-language framework.

methods.name: SimpleServiceEngine
methods.description: Constructor initializing the engine with a ServiceDispatcher.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously and returns the result map, throwing an exception if the result is null.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously and ignores the result.

methods.name: serviceInvoker
methods.description: Invokes a simple service method using the provided context, handling class loading and exceptions.
